 Guéhi’s reaction to Villa loss was fantastic, says Maresca 
 Jack Mumford 
 Tue 27 Oct 2026, 11:00 
 Share 
 Enzo Maresca says he’s pleased with Marc Guéhi’s reaction to Saturday’s Premier League defeat at Aston Villa. 
 Men's Team 
 How can I watch City v Brighton on TV around the globe? 
 The England international has been central to our fine start to the season, playing every minute in our table-topping league start until his half-time substitution at Villa Park.
 While Maresca says Guéhi has acknowledged his mistake in the buildup to Villa’s opener in the 2-1 loss, the manager is impressed with the defender’s ability to shake off the disappointment.
 “I’m completely, especially in this moment, happy with Marc,” said Maresca in Tuesday’s press conference before the Carabao Cup visit of Brighton on Wednesday.
 “The way he reacted was fantastic. He is a top guy, a leader, one of the captains and I love Marc to be honest.
 “When they make some mistakes, they recognise. Marc is aware now.
 Men's Team 
 Maresca provides squad update ahead of Brighton Carabao Cup clash 
 “He’s played all minutes since the start of the season with us and the international team. In the last two weeks he didn’t play Champions League game, he played 45 minutes the other day so he’s completely okay.”
 Rico Lewis replaced Guéhi in defence at Aston Villa, slotting in at right-back with Abdukodir Khusanov moving into the middle.
 The 21-year-old has only started against Norwich and AEK Athens so far, but Maresca says he’s prepared to utilise the Academy graduate in defence or further forward.
 “He can play both,” said Maresca when asked about which role he favours for Lewis.
 “In this moment, we have Nunes that has the injury so Lewis was good in the second half against Villa.
 “He can play full-back or midfield, it depends where we need him.”
 City v Brighton: £20 for adults and £1 for U18s
 Tickets are now on sale for our Carabao Cup fourth round meeting with Brighton.
 We host Fabian Hurzeler’s side at 19:30 (UK) on Wednesday 28 October.
 Tickets for adults start from just £20, with all U18s only £1 – and you can also buy up to six tickets per person.
 Taking place during half term school holidays too, it’s the perfect time to experience a night under the Etihad lights for all the family!
 And there will be so much to do beforehand, with a Kids Fanzone just over the road at the City Football Academy ahead of kick-off.
 Meanwhile, hospitality is available from just £100 with a range of packages on offer to suit your needs, whether a special occasion for a loved one or for something professional.
